monsters.name: Mutated Bloodveld
monsters.label: Mutated Bloodveld
notes: Mutated bloodvelds in the Catacombs of Kourend can drop ancient shards and dark totem pieces. They can be killed in multicombat.
In the Iorwerth Dungeon, mutated bloodveld can drop crystal shards. This location can only be accessed after completion of Song of the Elves.

The Meiyerditch Laboratories location is a multi-combat area where a dwarf multicannon can be used to kill mutated bloodveld. The area is only accessible with partial completion of Sins of the Father (after killing the mutated bloodveld during the quest). However, the run to the Meiyerditch Laboratories is fairly long, so it is recommended to use Prayer there instead of food. A shortcut through the abyss to the blood altar may be worth considering if you don't have the agility or mining level for the fairy ring shortcut, though it carries very significant risk going through the wilderness.

The Buccaneers' Laboratory location is also a multi-combat area where a dwarf multicannon can be used to kill mutated bloodveld. 76 Sailing is required to access this area. Players are recommended to build a rowboat on the island, which allows easy access through Pirates' Cove.

monsters.name: Insatiable mutated Bloodveld
monsters.label: Insatiable mutated Bloodveld
notes: Superior slayer monster variant, which has a chance of spawning on a mutated bloodveld's death after purchasing the Bigger and Badder unlock for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master.

monsters.name: Reanimated bloodveld
monsters.label: Reanimated bloodveld
notes: Using the Expert Reanimation spell on an ensouled bloodveld head, players can reanimate a bloodveld for greatly reduced slayer experience. However, the player also receives 1,040 Prayer experience for each kill.

If the spell is not cast within a reasonable amount of time of picking up the head, or if the player trades the head or teleports away, then the user will need to reanimate the heads at the Dark Altar in Kourend.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: There are three groups of mutated bloodvelds, in the north-east, south-east, and south-west.
The north-east location has the biggest cluster (seven) of mutated bloodvelds. It is an ideal area for using a goading potion.
The south-east location has five and is also suitable for goading potions.

The south-west location has six, but it is polluted by wandering possessed pickaxes. However, players can use the south-west path to the hill giants as a safespot. When attacking from the safespot (see image), try and attack Bloodvelds to the east of the safespot so they aggro and then get stuck on the corner, allowing for easier AFK killing
Monsters here have access to the Catacombs drop table, with superior variants always dropping a piece of the dark totem.
